verses.text: wa aalihi wa sahbihi wa anhimi
bilaa azan yaa khayra mubqin munhimi
salli wa sallim yaa muniilal birri
halal lazii sammayta haynal ghurri
wa aalihi wa sahbihi wa bil buruur
jud lii bilaa hadaawatin walaa ghuruur
salli wa saliimanna yaa ilaahii
halaa nabiyyil laahi sahdil laahi
wal aali was sahbi bilaa tanaahi
yaa man hamaaniya hanil manaahii
yaa man lahul amru kamislil khalqi
salli halal mukhtaari sahdil khalqi
wa salliman halayhi fil aali wa fii
sihaabihi fil haali summa maayafii
yaa baaqiyan lii kaana duuna ghumami
qudis salaata likhatiibil umami
wa salliman halayhi fil aali mahaa
sihaabihi yaa man duhaa-ii samihaa
salli bitasliimin halaa hizzil harab
wa raafihir rutabi kaashifil kurab
wa aalihi wa sahbihi waltahmadi
haazan nizaama hamda mughnin samadi
salli bitasliimin halaa zil faraji
badrit tamaami wa kariimil makhraji
wa aalihi mahas sihaabil kummali
warfah liwajhikal kariimi hamalii
yaa rabbanaa salli wa sallim sarmadaa
halan nabiyyi zil mazaayaa ahmadaa
yaa rabbanaa salli wa sallim abadaa
halar rasuuli was suruurii abbidaa
yaa rabbanaa salli wa sallim kulla hiin
halaa nabiyyika imaamis saalihiin
yaa rabbanaa salli wa sallim fii abad
halaa khaliilika siraaji man habad
yaa rabbanaa salli wa sallim sarmadaa
halal lazii samaytahu muhammadaa
wa aalihi wa sahbihi waghfir liman
yaqra uzan nizaama fii kulli zaman
wa hab lahu jumlata maa takhtaaru
lahu ladayka innakal mukhtaaru
wa hutta maa halayhi min zunuubi
yaa maali-an bijaahihi zanuubii
wa hab liman yaqra-uhu aw yaktubuh
khayral munaa yaa man atatnii kutubuh
wa hab liman hafizahu aw hassalah
bi-ayyi wajhin bin nabiyyi amalah
yaa rabbanaa wajjih salaatan bisalaam
liman lahu wa habta afdalal kalaam
yaa rabbanaa awsil salaamiyal qadiim
ilal lazii sirtu lahu khayra khadiim
yaa rabbanaa khallid salaamayka liman
wa habta lii bijaahihi khayra aman
yaa rabbanaa mudda salaamayka bilaa
nihaayatin liman salaatii qabilaa
yaa rabbanaa bashshir khaliilikal habiib
bikhidmatii wa kulla saalihin labiib
aamiina yaa rabbi bihaqqi wajhikaa
yaa waahidan laysa yuraamu shibhukaa
yaa man liwajhikal kariimmi zan nizaam
katabtu qud liyal ayaadiyal hizaam
bilaa azan walaa jawan walaa gharar
walaa hidan walaa balan walaa darar
yaa man liwajhikal kariimi zal kitaab
katabtu hab lii hismatan minal hitaab
fii kulli shay-in zaahiran wa baatinaa
wanfah bihi yaa maalikil mawaatinaa
wajhalhu nafhan lizawil amsaari
wa ghayrihim yaa waahibal ansaari
yaa zal araadii was samaa salli bilaa
haddin halaa man khidmatii qad qabilaa
sayyidinaa muhammadin wal aali
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa salliman halayhi waghfir yaa ghafuur
liqaari-iihi wa alin bihin nafuur
wajhal huruufa zan nizaama sarmadaa
bushaaratan haziimatan li-ahmadaa
wa salliyan wa salliman halayhi
fii aalihi wa man numii ilayhi
wadfah bihi qablat tawajjuhil lahiin
ilaa siwaa qaari-ihi antal muhiin
wajlub liman yaqra-uhu khayra muraad
wasluk-hu yaa rabbal waraa khayra maraad
wa hab liman yuqra-uhu maa yaghbituh
bihi siwaahu yaa jamiilan yunshituh
yaa zal bilaadi wa hibaadi salliyaa
wa salliman halan nabii wa kun liyaa
fii aalihi wa sahbihi waltarfahaa
ilayka sahyii bir ridaa yartafihaa
yaa rabbanaa salli wa sallim sarmadaa
halaa kariimi kullahu qad humidaa
sayyidinaa muhammadin khitaami man
arsaltahum kal anbiyaa yaa zaz zaman
wa aalihi wa sahbihi waltajhali
zan nazma khaariqan bihi yanjahili
yaa man amarta zawil iimaani kullahumu
bi-an yusalluu halal mukhtaari fir rusuli
minniq balanna salaatan qad lafaztu bihaa
nazman liwajhika yaa man qad mahaa kasalii
faqbal nizaamii wa sahyii kullahu karaman
walaa tarudda layaadan lii minal hamali
faqbalhu minniya fadlan laa munaaqashatan
wa qud bighayri hanaa-in lii bihi amalii
ushkur bifadlika sahyii wardayanna bihi
yaa man bihi sirtu zaa had-yin wa lam amili
antal kariimul lazii abghii takarrumahu
yaa khayra haadin hadaanii afdalas subuli
kun lii bijaahi rasuulil laahi maalikanaa
halayhi khayru salaatin minka han qibali
warfah nizaamiya zaa juudan wa takrimatan
walaa taruddannahu yaa muzhibal hilali
dumman nizaami ilaa sahyis sihaabi ghadan
walaa taruddannahu yaa muzhibal khalali
siwaaka lam arjuu fii sirrin wa fii halanin
bihaqqi wajhika haqqiq lir rajaa anali
yaa rabbi kun lii wa qud lii bir ridaa gharadii
wa mal tamastu bijaahil muntaqaa anili
salli wa sallim halal mukhtaari fil kuramaa
wa bashshiranna binazmii afdalar rusuuli
